craft_notes: Sthāyin: remembering the valiant. Device: em-dash→comma (tasks stated softly, minding lands). Rejected: 'tough' for 'knotty' — killed: duṣkara kept hard. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Make the knotty naught, sweeten the smart likewise,
sole doughty is mind of him: him mind we, Love's bane.
l4.sanskrit_cite: duṣkaraṃ sukarīkartuṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhayituṃ tathā ekavīrā smṛtir yasya taṃ smarāmaḥ smaradviṣam

reads_against.argmap: To make hard easy, to gladden suffering likewise.; Sole-heroic is whose remembrance: him we remember, love's foe. → Remember love's foe, whose remembrance conquers hardship.
c1_essence: Hard made handy, bitter sweetened: sole-valiant memory minds love's bane.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śṛṅgāra-bhakti with karuṇā (love pleading through dread)
reads_against.l2: Make the hard handy and sweeten the bitter — his memory alone is valiant: him we mind, the lover's bane.
l3: Make the knotty naught, sweeten the smart likewise —
